scope: Fixed-checkpoint prospective evaluation; existing four-seed equal-budget constructions; no new training, width tuning or final-outcome model selection
sample_size_policy: Fixed precision-limited budget of 20 independent source blocks per task; no optional stopping; no power guarantee.
primary_effect: PAP-Affine minus baseline; average over four seeds, equal source blocks, equal environments
meaningful_effect_policy: Report magnitudes in existing normalized loss and physical units; no categorical practical-superiority claim without a prespecified external margin.
source_recipe: Independent blocks; source geometry jitter +/-18mm and yaw +/-0.15rad; three descendants jitter +/-2mm and +/-0.02rad; matched alternating contact offset; RollBall heading fixed.
lineage: All descendants cluster with their source block; fresh preparation seed plus a unique block recipe per block.
failures: No exclusion for unsuccessful execution or invalid joints. Nonfinite observations or context mismatch stop the affected run and prevent complete-cohort superiority claims. Infrastructure retries retain exact cases.
source_population_caveat: Same environment physical parameters; no claim of transfer to arbitrary hidden physics.
